+        with patch("ingest.warehouse.urllib.request.urlopen", return_value=response) as post:

+        self.assertTrue(all(len(body) <= MAX_REQUEST_BYTES for body in bodies))
+        self.assertEqual([row for body in bodies for row in json.loads(body)["rows"]], rows)
